name: kp-cms-3
description: KP CMS with Bruno API tests

scripts.test:managed: sh -c 'if curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Port 18080 is already in use. Stop that server and rerun npm test."; exit 1; fi; npm run auth:reset:testdata && KP_BOOTSTRAP_USER=admin KP_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD=admin go run ./server/cmd/server --data-dir ./data-test --port 18080 > /tmp/kp-api-all.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap "kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT; i=0; until curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge 30 ]; then echo "Server failed to become ready. See /tmp/kp-api-all.log"; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; cd api && bru run system/health.yml system/status.yml auth/login.yml stores/get_all.yml cases/get_all.yml files/get_all.yml backups/get_all.yml jobs/get_all.yml auth/logout.yml --env-file environments/test.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:18080 --env-var auth_username=admin --env-var auth_password=admin --bail --noproxy && bru run system/health.yml system/status.yml system/setup.yml auth/login.yml stores/reload.yml stores/create.yml cases/create.yml cases/get_one.yml cases/put.yml cases/patch.yml files/upload.yml files/get_all.yml files/get_one.yml files/rename.yml files/delete.yml backups/create.yml backups/get_all.yml backups/restore.yml jobs/get_all.yml jobs/cancel.yml cases/delete.yml auth/logout.yml --env-file environments/test.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:18080 --env-var auth_username=admin --env-var auth_password=admin --bail --noproxy'
scripts.test:smoke: cd api && bru run system/health.yml system/status.yml auth/login.yml stores/get_all.yml cases/get_all.yml files/get_all.yml backups/get_all.yml jobs/get_all.yml auth/logout.yml --env-file environments/test.json --bail --noproxy
scripts.test:mutation: cd api && bru run system/health.yml system/status.yml system/setup.yml auth/login.yml stores/reload.yml stores/create.yml cases/create.yml cases/get_one.yml cases/put.yml cases/patch.yml files/upload.yml files/get_all.yml files/get_one.yml files/rename.yml files/delete.yml backups/create.yml backups/get_all.yml backups/restore.yml jobs/get_all.yml jobs/cancel.yml cases/delete.yml auth/logout.yml --env-file environments/test.json --bail --noproxy
